text.content:
A labouring tradesman who hauls raw aether up out of the ground, wielding elemental force as engineering rather than magic.

SKILLS

EARTHMELD · SL max 2

SL 1: You have the ability to move through solid stone and dirt without disturbing it. If solid ground is available, you may use an action and spend 1 Fabula Point to sink into it to take cover for the rest of a scene. You will have to emerge from the earth nearby.

SL 2: You can take willing creatures with you a short distance — through a wall or rockfall, for instance. (If you release a creature, the magic launches them to the surface in an unpredictable direction; you can't trap them, though you could try this as an unconventional travel method.)

ELEMENTALIST'S WAY · SL max 10

Each time you acquire this Skill, learn one Elementalist spell. Offensive spells use (INS + WLP) for the Magic Check.

MINERAL RESILIENCE

As a free action, spend 5 Mind Points. Until the end of the scene, you reduce all physical damage you take by 5.

STABLE GROUND · SL max 3

You are immune to environmental effects that would affect you via dangerous ground (for example, marshy ground inflicting slow or unstable footing filling a clock towards an avalanche.) The GM is the final arbiter on what counts. You may extend this benefit to other creatures for the rest of a scene by spending (20 − 5 × SL) MP for each creature. (15 MP at level 1, 10 at level 2, and 5 at level 3.)

TRADESMAN'S EYE

You always have the tools you need to work stone or metal — even types you've never seen before — without spending Inventory Points. Additionally, whenever you fill in or erase a segment of a clock related to building, reinforcing, or destroying a structure made of stone, metal, or living wood, you may fill in or erase an additional segment.

SPELLS

Tectonomancer Spells

Earthworks 10 MP\*T Up to 3 creatures Scene Trenches collapse and barriers spring up to protect your allies. Your targets cannot be targeted by ranged attacks. Any creature that targets them with a melee attack is considered to be in the trenches. The effect of this spell on a target ends when they make a melee attack against a creature that isn’t in the trenches or otherwise leave its protection (such as by taking flight.)

Eruption🗲 10 MP\*T Up to 3 creatures Instantaneous Magma surges, flinging boulders high into the air. Each non-flying target hit by this spell suffers \[HR+15\] fire damage, and each flying target hit suffers \[HR+15\] earth damage. Opportunity: Each target hit by this spell suffers shaken.

Graviton🗲 20 MP One creature Instantaneous The Earth beckons your foe into its embrace. The target suffers \[HR+25\] earth damage. A flying target lands immediately and can’t take off in their next turn. Damage dealt by this spell ignores resistances.

Megathrust 20 MP Instantaneous Each creature on the scene that isn’t flying, floating, falling, or otherwise in mid-air takes 30 earth damage. Creatures that are being protected by the Stable Ground Skill have resistance to this damage.

Might of Antaeus 20 MP One creature Scene The strength of the earth itself surges through your ally. Until this spell ends, the target treats their Might and Willpower attributes as one die size higher (up to a maximum of d12) and is immune to weak and shaken as long as they are standing on solid ground. They lose the benefit in mid-air, on a platform, or on the deck of a ship, but regain it if they reach the ground again during this scene.

Note: in practical terms, this means there are encounters you just won’t be able to use it in. Quicksand🗲 5 MP\*T Up to 5 creatures Instantaneous The ground turns into thick, clinging muck beneath your foes. Each target hit by the spell suffers \[HR+5\] earth damage and slow. This spell cannot target creatures who are flying, floating, falling, or otherwise in mid-air. Opportunity: Choose one target hit by this spell. They perform one fewer action on their next turn (to a minimum of 0 actions.)

Orogeny 10 MP One creature Instantaneous Your target is lifted by a spire of rock. Until they voluntarily slide down, they can only be reached in melee by flying creatures, and likewise can only use melee attacks against flying creatures. If there is a ceiling (e.g. in a cavern underground), this spell instead functions as Terra, except it can still only target one creature.

Permafrost🗲 10 MP\*T Up to 3 creatures Instantaneous Ice permeates the earth and steals the enemy’s vital warmth. Each target hit by this spell suffers \[HR+15\] ice damage and can’t burrow or emerge from the earth during their next turn. This spell can target creatures who are otherwise protected underground, but cannot target creatures who are flying, floating, falling, or otherwise in mid-air. Opportunity: Each target hit by this spell suffers weak.

Stone’s Throw 10 MP Self Scene Better rock tossing through magic\! You create three Perfect Stones as the following thrown weapon: Perfect Stones \[MIG+DEX\] or \[INS+WLP\] \[HR+10\] earth One-handed◆Ranged◆Limited (3), Opportunity: each target hit suffers dazed. If you have a free hand slot as you cast this spell, you may equip the Perfect Stones to it and make a free attack with one as part of the same action. When you’ve attacked with your third Perfect Stone, the effects of the spell end.

Terra🗲 10 MP\*T Up to 3 creatures Instantaneous Spires of jagged rock erupt from the ground beneath your foes, closing around them. Each target hit by this spell suffers \[HR+15\] earth damage. This spell cannot target creatures who are flying, floating, falling, or otherwise in mid-air. Opportunity: Each target hit by this spell performs one fewer action on their next turn (to a minimum of 0 actions.)

Note: if you have this spell from Elementalist, you can’t get it from this class, and vice-versa.

Tremor🗲 5 MP\*T Up to 5 creatures Instantaneous You delicately pluck at the earth so that the damage doesn’t spread beyond your targets. Each target hit by the spell suffers \[HR+10\] earth damage. This spell cannot target creatures who are flying, floating, falling, or otherwise in mid-air. Opportunity: On your next turn, you may cast Aftershock on all of the same targets who are still eligible, either before or after your action. It’s a copy of Tremor that doesn’t use your action and doesn’t have this Opportunity.

Vulcan’s Vent🗲 15 MP\*T Up to 3 creatures Instantaneous The earth splits and noxious fumes spill forth. Each target hit by this spell suffers \[HR+15\] poison damage. Your targets’ magic defense is set to their dexterity die against this spell. Opportunity: Each target hit by this spell suffers poisoned.
